mkdir -p $TMPDIR/scripts && cat > $TMPDIR/scripts/extract.py <<'EOF'
import re,glob,os,json
D='/tmp/r2run-cfwtiw3m/data/text'
out=[]
for f in sorted(glob.glob(D+'/*.txt')):
    t=open(f,encoding='utf-8',errors='replace').read()
    pages=re.split(r'=== page \d+',t)
    for p in pages:
        if 'Case Number' not in p: continue
        cn=re.search(r'Case Number:\s*(\S+)',p)
        resp=re.search(r'Respondent:\s*(.*)',p)
        cite=re.search(r'finds the following violation\(s\):\s*(.*?)\n\s*\n',p,re.S)
        rec=re.search(r'recommends the following civil penalty:(.*?)(?:Abstentions|Additional Information|APPROVED|$)',p,re.S)
        out.append(dict(file=os.path.basename(f),case=cn.group(1) if cn else None,
            resp=resp.group(1).strip() if resp else None,
            cite=' '.join(cite.group(1).split()) if cite else None,
            rec=' '.join(rec.group(1).split()) if rec else None))
json.dump(out,open(os.environ['TMPDIR']+'/scripts/cases.json','w'),indent=1)
print(len(out))
for o in out: print(o['file'],'|',o['case'],'|',o['cite'],'|',o['rec'])
EOF
python3 -I $TMPDIR/scripts/extract.py
